```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 1000
library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(data.table)

######### Data Preparation #########
# Updated data URL
data_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/santi-rios/China-Chemical-Dominance/refs/heads/main/data/fig_1_complete.csv"

# Load and preprocess data
df <- fread(data_url) %>% 
  mutate(Country = as.factor(Country), source = as.factor(source))

######### Custom Labels #########
figure_labels <- list(
  "Figure1-a" = list(y_title = "Contribution Index", map_title = "Chemical Space Contribution"), 
  "Figure12-a_b" = list(y_title = "Contribution Index", map_title = "Chemical Space Contribution"), 
  "Figure1-b" = list(y_title = "Collaboration Index", map_title = "International Collaborations"),
  "Figure1-c" = list(y_title = "Collaboration Percentage", map_title = "China-US Collaboration"),
  "Figure1-d" = list(y_title = "GDP Growth Rate (%)", map_title = "Economic Indicators"),
  "Figure1-e" = list(y_title = "Researchers (Count)", map_title = "R&D Workforce")
)

######### APP #########
ui <- fluidPage(
  theme = bs_theme(bootswatch = "flatly", primary = "#2c3e50", secondary = "#18bc9c"),
  
  # Navbar
  div(
    class = "navbar navbar-static-top primary bg-primary",
    div("China's Rise in the Chemical Space and the Decline of US Influence", 
        class = "container-fluid")
  ),
  
  # Control Panel
  card(
    card_header("Controls", class = "bg-primary text-light"),
    card_body(
      # Select Figure
      selectInput(
        inputId = "facet", 
        label = "Select Figure:",
        choices = levels(df$source),
        selected = "Figure1-a",
        width = "100%"
      ),
      
      # Year Slider without Animation
      sliderInput(
        inputId = "year", 
        label = "Year",
        min = min(df$Year, na.rm = TRUE),
        max = max(df$Year, na.rm = TRUE) - 1,
        value = min(df$Year, na.rm = TRUE),
        step = 1,
        animate = FALSE,  # Removed animation to enhance performance
        width = "100%"
      ),
      
      # UI Output for Figure Description
      uiOutput("figure_description")
    )
  ),
  
  # Visualization Panel
  card(
    full_screen = TRUE,
    card_header("Interactive Visualizations", class = "bg-primary text-light"),
    card_body(
      plotlyOutput("emissionsPlot", height = "50vh"),
      br(),
      plotlyOutput("worldMap", height = "40vh"),
      # New UI output for the cartogram image (only visible for Figure1-a)
      uiOutput("cartogramImage")
    )
  ),
  
  # Footer
  div(
    class = "footer navbar navbar-static-bottom bg-light",
    style = "margin-bottom: 20px;",
    div(
      class = "container-fluid",
      "Data source: Bermudez-Montana, Garcia-Chung, et al, 2025 - ",
      a("ChemRxiv Publication", href = "https://doi.org/10.26434/chemrxiv-2025-d2zc8",
        style = "color: #18bc9c;")
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  ######### Reactive Values #########
  # Initialize selected_countries with top 20 countries based on highest Value for the selected facet
  selected_countries <- reactiveVal(NULL)
  
  ######### Observers #########
  
  # Update selected countries when facet changes
  observeEvent(input$facet, {
    countries <- df[source == input$facet, .(max_value = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE)), by = Country] %>%
      arrange(desc(max_value)) %>%
      head(20) %>%
      pull(Country)
    selected_countries(countries)
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)
  
  # Handle plotly legend clicks for emissionsPlot to synchronize selections
  observeEvent(event_data("plotly_legendclick", source = "emissions"), {
    click <- event_data("plotly_legendclick", source = "emissions")
    current <- selected_countries()
    
    if (!is.null(click$name)) {
      if (click$name %in% current) {
        updated <- setdiff(current, click$name)
      } else {
        updated <- c(current, click$name)
      }
      # Limit the number of selected countries to prevent performance issues
      if (length(updated) > 50) {  # Example threshold
        showNotification("You have selected too many countries. Please deselect some to improve performance.", type = "warning")
        updated <- head(updated, 50)
      }
      selected_countries(updated)
    }
  })
  
  # Debounced reactive for the year slider to throttle rapid changes
  selected_year <- debounce(reactive(input$year), 300)
  
  # Reactive axis labels
  axis_labels <- reactive({
    figure_labels[[input$facet]] %||% list(y_title = "Value", map_title = "Value")
  })
  
  # Filtered data based on selected countries and facet
  filtered_data <- reactive({
    req(input$facet, selected_countries())
    df[source == input$facet & Country %in% selected_countries()]
  })
  
  ######### UI Outputs #########
  
  # Figure description
  output$figure_description <- renderUI({
    desc_text <- switch(input$facet,
      "Figure1-a" = "Country participation in chemical space growth using the formula:",
      "Figure12-a_b" = "Country participation in chemical space growth using the formula:",
      "Figure1-b" = "Top international collaborations in chemical research:",
      "Figure1-c" = "China-US collaborative contributions to new substances:",
      "Figure1-d" = "Economic indicators and major events timeline:",
      "Figure1-e" = "Research workforce development metrics:",
      paste("Displaying:", input$facet)
    )
    
    div(class = "callout",
        h5(desc_text),
        if(input$facet %in% c("Figure1-a", "Figure12-a_b")) 
          withMathJax(helpText("$$C_{i,t} = \\frac{1}{n_t} \\sum_s \\frac{n_{i,s,t}}{n_{a,s,t}}$$"))
    )
  })
  
  ######### Emissions Plot #########
  
######### Emissions Plot #########
output$emissionsPlot <- renderPlotly({
    req(filtered_data(), selected_year())
    
    plot_data <- filtered_data()[Year <= selected_year()]
    if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) return(plotly_empty())
    
    # Create the line plot
    fig <- plot_ly(
      plot_data, 
      x = ~Year, 
      y = ~Value, 
      color = ~Country,
      colors = "Set1",
      type = 'scatter', 
      mode = 'lines+markers', 
      line = list(width = 1),
      marker = list(size = 4),
      hoverinfo = 'text',
      text = ~paste0("<b>", Country, "</b><br>",
                     axis_labels()$y_title, ": ", round(Value, 2),
                     "<br>Year: ", Year),
      source = "emissions",
      showlegend = TRUE
    ) %>%
      # Register the legend click event here
      event_register('plotly_legendclick') %>%
      layout(
        title = paste("Temporal Analysis -", input$facet),
        xaxis = list(title = "Year", gridcolor = "#ecf0f1"),
        yaxis = list(title = axis_labels()$y_title, gridcolor = "#ecf0f1"),
        hovermode = "closest",
        plot_bgcolor = "#ffffff",
        legend = list(
          orientation = 'h', 
          y = -0.2, 
          itemclick = "toggle", 
          itemdoubleclick = FALSE
        ),
        margin = list(r = 40)
      )
    
    if (input$facet == "Figure1-d") {
      fig <- fig %>% 
        add_annotations(x = 2020, y = 10, text = "COVID-19", showarrow = FALSE, font = list(size = 8)) %>%
        add_annotations(x = 2007, y = 15, text = "Global Financial Crisis", showarrow = FALSE, font = list(size = 8))
    }
    
    return(fig)
})
  
  ######### World Map #########
  
  output$worldMap <- renderPlotly({
    req(filtered_data(), selected_year())
    
    map_data <- filtered_data()[Year == selected_year()]
    if (nrow(map_data) == 0) return(plotly_empty())
    
    # Create the world map plot
    fig <- plot_geo(map_data, height = 300) %>%
      add_trace(
        z = ~Value,
        color = ~Value,
        colors = "Blues",
        locations = ~iso3c,
        text = ~paste0("<b>", Country, "</b><br>",
                      axis_labels()$map_title, ": ", round(Value, 2)),
        hoverinfo = "text",
        marker = list(line = list(color = "white", width = 0.5)),
        source = "map"
      ) %>%
      colorbar(title = axis_labels()$map_title, 
               orientation = 'h', y = -0.1) %>%
      layout(
        title = paste("Global Distribution -", input$facet, "(", selected_year(), ")"),
        geo = list(
          showframe = FALSE,
          showcoastlines = TRUE,
          projection = list(type = "natural earth"),
          bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
          landcolor = "#f8f9fa"
        ),
        margin = list(b = 80)
      )
    
    return(fig)
  })
  
  ######### Cartogram Image for Figure1-a #########
  
  output$cartogramImage <- renderUI({
    req(selected_year())
    # Only show the image if the selected facet is "Figure1-a"
    if (input$facet == "Figure1-a") {
      tags$div(
        style = "text-align: center; margin-top: 10px;",
        tags$img(src = paste0("cartograms/", selected_year(), ".png"),
                 style = "max-width: 100%; height: auto;")
      )
    } else {
      return(NULL)
    }
  })
}

# Run the application 
shinyApp(ui, server)
```

## Chemical Space Analysis


$$
C_{i,t} = \frac{1}{n_t} \sum_s \frac{n_{i,s,t}}{n_{a,s,t}}
$$

**Description of Elements:**

- $Ci,tCi,t$: Contribution of country ii to the chemical space (CS) expansion in year tt.
- $ntnt$: Total number of new reported chemicals in year tt.
- $ss$: Index representing a specific chemical substance.
- $ni,s,tni,s,t$: Number of authors from country ii who published substance ss for the first time in year tt.
- $na,s,tna,s,t$: Total number of authors participating in the publication of substance ss in year tt.

::: {.callout-note}

This formula calculates the weighted contribution of a country to the discovery of new chemical substances. The contribution is proportional to the number of authors from a specific country relative to the total number of authors involved in reporting each substance. Finally, this contribution is normalized by the total number of new substances for that year.
:::
